title: Hereditary Lowerability of Topological Dynamical Systems
summary: Let $(X,T)$ be a topological dynamical system and let $h(T,K)$ denote the topological entropy of a compact set $K\subset X$. We settle a question and a conjecture raised by Huang, Ye, and Zhang (2014) concerning hereditary lowerability. First, we show that every system with finite topological entropy is hereditarily lowerable: for every nonempty compact set $K\subset X$ and every $0\leq h\leq h(T,K)$, there is a compact set $K_h\subset K$ such that $h(T,K_h)=h$.
